profile.name: 铭禾 MHS-5200A 双通道函数发生器
profile.description: MHS-5200A 是一款低成本双通道函数发生器，可输出常见测试波形，用于电子实验、教学演示、信号注入和台式电路调试。它适合为被测电路提供可调频率、相位、偏置和占空比的激励信号。
profile.description_en: The MHS-5200A is a low-cost dual-channel function generator that outputs common test waveforms for electronics experiments, teaching, signal injection, and bench-top circuit debugging. It is used to provide adjustable excitation signals with controllable frequency, phase, offset, and duty cycle.
